Chapter 956 Chapter 17: Clashing With The Ultimate (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 956  Chapter 17: Clashing with the Ultimate (Please Subscribe)

Mists shrouded from all directions.

In front of the more than a dozen towering figures that arrived silently, even the time-space black holes covering thousands to tens of thousands of light-years seemed slightly insignificant.

"Alien race Level Twelve?"

Lin Yuan looked at the many Level Twelve ultimates that sealed off time and space, his heart devoid of panic; instead, a hint of surprise arose.

How did these alien Level Twelve ultimates lock onto his exact coordinates?

"The causality with a certain Level Twelve being surged by tens of thousands of times in a short period?"

Lin Yuan took a closer inspection and found the reason.

He was also aware of some secret techniques to temporarily increase causality.

But not without paying a huge price.

Especially with Lin Yuan's understanding of the rules of causality, trying to lock on to him via causality?

Even for a Level Twelve ultimate, they would have to suffer serious injuries that wouldn't heal for tens of millions of years.

Boom!!!

At this moment, the Tianyu Clan ancestor pressed down with a palm, aiming to directly suppress Lin Yuan.

The other Level Twelve ultimates did not take action but coldly observed from the sidelines, believing that the ancestor of the Tianyu Clan alone was sufficient.

No matter how talented the Galaxy Master was, he was merely a Level Eleven being, and it was impossible to block the hand of a Level Twelve ultimate.

The Tianyu Clan ancestor thought so too.

From the birth of the universe to the present, even adding the occasional news from outside the universe in the Chaos Void, they had never heard of a Level Eleven being able to contend with a Level Twelve being.

...

"Hmm?"

The human civilization's borders, the Xuanyuan Supreme, Xia Qin Supreme, their expressions suddenly changed.

How huge was the commotion when a Level Twelve ultimate made a move? It simply couldn't be concealed. The moment the presence of more than ten Level Twelve ultimates descended on the time-space black hole, the instant the Tianyu Clan ultimate made a move.

The nine Supremes of human civilization noticed it.

"Those old guys..."

The Xuanyuan Supreme's thoughts raced at a staggering speed, immediately conjecturing that the more than ten alien Level Twelve beings were likely targeting Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan concealed his own causality so that not only did the alien Level Twelve beings have difficulty detecting anything, the Supremes of human civilization were also unable to sense much through causal sensing.

Rustle...

The true body of the Xuanyuan Supreme took a step out, spanning billions of light-years in an instant, rushing towards the location of the time-space black hole.

The other human civilization Supremes did the same.

"Lin Yuan..." Xia Qin Supreme harbored worries in his heart.

More than a hundred years ago, he had planned to send Lin Yuan's true self into the Central Star Domain, the safest place in the entire human civilization.

It was only after learning that Lin Yuan had become the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm that he abandoned this idea.

In terms of safety, where could be safer than the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?

"With the Xuanhuang Secret Realm separating causality, those old guys can't affect Lin Yuan's true self at all, and as for memory contamination? The Galaxy Master's willpower is no weaker than any of us Level Twelves; memory contamination is also not feasible."

Xia Qin Supreme's thoughts rapidly turned, and he slightly relaxed.

In his view, those alien Level Twelves could not really do anything to the Galaxy Master this time; at most, they could kill an avatar or embodiment of the Galaxy Master.

Of course.

Even so, Xia Qin Supreme and the other nine Supremes of human civilization did not slow down at all.

Those alien Level Twelves not being able to do anything to Lin Yuan was one thing.

But making a move against Lin Yuan was another.

Even if they had not affected Lin Yuan at all, as Level Twelve beings taking action against a Level Eleven life, it was a violation of the unwritten rules among Level Twelve ultimates!

...

Rumbling.

The pressure of space-time grew increasingly heavy.

The Tianyu Clan ancestor's gaze was cold as he looked down on Lin Yuan, his pressing right hand not pausing for a moment.

From the moment of arrival, everything happened in the blink of an eye, and even if the Galaxy Master managed to react forcibly, wanting to self-destruct this avatar, it was too late.

Self-destructing an avatar requires time.

By the time the command to self-detonate the avatar reached them, his palm would have already suppressed it.

However.

The next moment.

Under the incredulous gazes of the surrounding more than ten Level Twelve ultimates.

The Galaxy Master, who had been standing quietly at a distance, as if petrified by fear, took a small step backward.

A mere step's distance, yet it seemed as though separated by an entire universe; the Tianyu Clan ancestor's palm incredibly missed its target.

The violent fluctuations of space-time, capable of annihilating a Level Eleven Perfect in both form and spirit, quieted down rapidly when nearing Lin Yuan's surroundings by several meters.

"What?"

The Tianyu Clan ancestor was somewhat dazed; his Level Twelve ultimate strike had unexpectedly missed.

Before this, the Tianyu Clan ancestor had envisioned every possibility, such as Lin Yuan withstanding the blow by relying on the heritage weapon of human civilization.

Of course, this possibility was slim.

How precious were heritage weapons? How could they allow an avatar or embodiment to carry it? The Clan Suppression Weapons carried by the numerous strongest Level Eleven beings in the super-large battlefield were all under the watchful eyes of the various Level Twelve ultimates.

But to miss entirely?

The Tianyu Clan ancestor could not understand. He could feel that this was a pure contest at the level of rules.

Blocking his palm by sheer force might be aided by external forces, but a contest at the level of rules? It meant that the Galaxy Master's comprehension of the rules was not at all inferior to his.

The Level Twelve ultimates surrounding him looked on with serious eyes; at this moment, they were certain that the Galaxy Master, in terms of rule comprehension, had reached the Level Twelve threshold fully.

Even more than just reaching their level but surpassing them.

After all, under comprehension of the same level of rules, Lin Yuan, with his Level Eleven status, easily made a palm strike of such a Level Twelve being from Tianyu Clan miss, which wasn't explainable by mere same-level rule comprehension.
